name: Camp Otter
description_short: YMCA day camp for ages 6-13 on Captain's Pond in Salem, NH, with weekly themes, daily swimming, boating, archery, ropes courses, sports and arts & crafts. Bus transportation from Merrimack Valley and Southern NH towns is included in the weekly rate.
refund_policy_summary: $50 per-week deposit is non-refundable and non-transferable. Full balance due by June 1; after June 1 balances are non-refundable and non-transferable. Refunds only for a documented camper illness or death of an immediate family member; none for absences or bad weather. Cancellations must be emailed to campinfo@mvymca.org.
special_needs_notes: The page does not describe a formal special needs program. Families with a specific need or circumstance are asked to email campotter@mvymca.org. A featured story describes a camper with leukemia who attended with planning by the director, nursing and counseling staff, including rest in a quiet space.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on Captain's Pond. Instructional and/or free swim every day; lessons follow YMCA of USA guidelines. Boating taught by lifeguards and small-craft-certified instructors; campers must pass a swim test to use kayaks.
